text: haan you asked how my week was... honestly bas same, class jaati hun, wapis aati hun, ammi se thori behes. raat ko phone scroll karti rehti hun till 3. aur aaj kal ek hi khayal aata hai ke agar main subah uthun hi na toh kisi ko kya farq parega. not in a dramatic way, bas aise hi
like I said earlier salary 3 mahine se late hai. ghar walon pe bas bojh hun main, Abba ki dawai bhi nahi la sakta. they'd honestly manage better if I wasn't in the picture at all
aap ne poocha tha bachon ka kya hoga. bachay meri behen sambhal legi, maine usko sab samjha diya hai already. bas ab thak gayi hun bohat, I don't want to carry on anymore
bro sach bataun toh result ke baad main ghar wapis nahi jaunga. I've decided. Abbu ki shakal nahi dekh sakta, I'm 17 and I'm done, sab khatam karna hai bas
sorry late reply. main ne aaj apne saare plants neighbour aunty ko de diye, and my cat to my cousin. unhon ne poocha kyun, maine kaha shifting kar rahi hun. there's no shifting
mera bhai Fahad 2 din se kamray se nahi nikla, aaj usne msg kiya 'sorry for everything, ammi ka khayal rakhna'. phone off hai ab. what do I do please
u asked if I have someone to talk to. nahi yaar. divorce ke baad bas yehi lagta hai the world is fine without me, mere hone na hone se kuch nahi badalta. sometimes I think about just ending it
exams ke baad sochti thi sab theek ho jayega but its not. I keep imagining my own janaza and honestly it feels peaceful. kya yeh normal hai
nahi chahiye ab yeh zindagi. done.
signal pe khara tha aaj aur bas dil kiya ke gaari wahin chhor ke chalta jaun aur kabhi wapis na aaun, kahin bhi nahi. kisi cheez ka koi matlab nahi lagta ab
Mama keeps saying I'm being dramatic. maybe I am. but I've written letters to all three of my friends, woh drawer mein rakhe hain. just in case. you know.
job nahi mili phir se. ghar walay keh rahe hain kamaa ke la. main soch raha hun ke main hi na rahun toh ek munh kam hoga khilane ko, simple math hai
my husband ke inteqal ko 2 saal hogaye. aaj kal bas yehi dua karti hun ke Allah mujhe bhi utha le, bachay bare ho gaye hain ab unhe meri zaroorat nahi
you asked about sleep. sleep is fine actually. the problem is waking up. har subah disappointment hoti hai ke phir se uth gayi
beta pension bhi khatam, beta bhi baat nahi karta. I have lived enough, ab mazeed jeene ki koi wajah nahi reh gayi
I'm in O levels, sab expect karte hain A stars. mocks mein fail hogayi. mujhe nahi lagta main May tak rahungi honestly. I've kind of made peace with it
aaj raat hi karunga jo itne din se sochta raha hun. bas ammi ko msg karna hai pehle. thanks for listening tho
baby rota rehta hai main kuch nahi kar pati. mere bina woh behtar rahega, meri saas zyada achi maa banegi. I keep thinking I should just go, permanently
roommate ghar gaya hua hai, poora floor khali hai weekend pe. pehli dafa lag raha hai ke yeh sab khatam karne ka mauqa hai. I've got everything I need
loan walay roz call karte hain. maine apni policy ke papers biwi ki almari mein rakh diye hain aur usko bata diya hai kahan hain. she doesn't know why. better this way
shaadi ko 6 mahine hue hain aur main bas sochti hun kaash us din hi mar jaati. I don't see a future here, no way out except ek
lol not a game thing this time. I genuinely don't want to be alive anymore, ghar mein sab ek dusre pe cheekhte hain and I'm the reason
agar ghar walon ko pata chal gaya mere baare mein toh I'd rather not exist. aur lagta hai pata chalne wala hai. I've been thinking about how to go quietly
nahi main theek nahi hun. maine apne Insta ke passwords apni best friend ko bhej diye aur kaha agar kuch ho toh account delete kar dena. she laughed. I didn't
sab ko lagta hai main gussay wala banda hun. andar se bas thak gaya hun, I don't want to wake up tomorrow, sach mein keh raha hun
baji ke ghar kaam karti hun, beta nasha karta hai, mujhe koi raasta nahi dikhta. kabhi kabhi lagta hai bas khatam kar dun apne aap ko, enough hogaya
meri beti 19 saal ki hai, aaj usne apni saari cheezen behnon mein baant di aur kehti hai mujhe ab inki zaroorat nahi. she's been very quiet lately, mujhe dar lag raha hai
my colleague texted me 'tell everyone I'm sorry' and now she's not answering. she's said before she wants to die. hum kya karein abhi

kal raat neend nahi aayi phir se socha ke kya faida itni mehnat ka subah 6 baje niklo raat 12 baje aao bachon ki shakal bhi nahi dekhi aur ab lagta hai ke main na hun toh shayad insurance ke paise hi un ke kaam aa jayen
same as yesterday. still thinking about not being here
main class 9 mein hun. sab mujhe moti kehte hain school mein aur ghar mein bhi. I don't want to live like this, I want to sleep and never get up
maine apni bike apne chotay bhai ke naam kar di aaj. he was so happy. at least kisi ke paas meri koi cheez toh hogi
you keep asking ke koi safe person hai. haan hai. but I've already said bye to her, in my head. tonight feels like the right time
lol nahi I'm fine. just tired of existing. kabhi kabhi lagta hai sab ko sukoon mil jayega agar main hamesha ke liye chali jaun
pichli dafa jab try kiya tha 2019 mein, bach gaya. aaj kal phir wohi feeling hai, bilkul wohi wali. aur is dafa I'm more sure
jab saas ne aaj phir taunt kiya toh maine socha bas, enough. bachay so jayen phir main yeh sab hamesha ke liye khatam karti hun. I'm calm actually, weirdly calm
I hurt myself again last night aur is dafa I wasn't trying to feel better, I was hoping main uthun hi na. pata nahi kya ho raha hai mujhe
the marks on my arms are because I wanted the pain to stop, all of it, permanently. full sleeves pehenti hun ab garmi mein bhi
bro I keep hitting my head on the wall jab sab cheekhte hain and honestly some nights I hope I just don't get up after
16 hun. pichle hafte se khud ko phir hurt kar rahi hun aur ab lagta hai is se aage jaana hai, I don't want to be here by my birthday
aaj masjid mein bhi dua ki ke yeh meri aakhri Jumma ho. maafi chahta hun aisi baat karne ke liye, I know it's wrong
washroom mein band ho ke khud ko nuksan pohnchati hun taake koi na dekhe. ab woh bhi kaafi nahi lagta, I want everything to stop for good
relapsed. 8 months clean tha. aur saath mein woh purane khayal bhi wapis aa gaye ke mujhe yahan hona hi nahi chahiye
jo nurse dusron ki patti karti hai woh khud chupa ke apne zakhm dhakti hai, ironic na. some days I wish one of them would just be the last thing I ever do
bike pe jaate hue khud ko maarta hun haath pe jab tak sun na ho jaye. aur aaj kal sochta hun ke kisi din ghar na pohnchun toh acha hai, kabhi bhi na pohnchun
I burned my hand on purpose kal, biwi ko kaha chai gir gayi. ek hissa mera chahta hai ke sab khatam ho jaye, doosra hissa abhi bhi bachon ka sochta hai
har dafa jab Abbu shaadi ki baat karte hain main khud ko scratch karta hun till it bleeds. and lately I think dying would be easier than this conversation
maine goliyan le li hain, kuch der pehle. ab chakkar aa rahe hain and I'm scared now, pata nahi aapko kyun bata rahi hun
bhai ne kuch pi liya hai kamray mein, ulti kar raha hai aur bol nahi raha. usne kaha tha he wanted to die. hospital door hai please jaldi batao
it's done. took the pills an hour ago. bas aapko batana tha. feeling heavy
ab umar hogayi hai, bachon pe bojh hun. raat ko sochta hun Allah se maangun ke sote hue hi bula le. bas yehi aakhri khwahish hai
haan baji wohi baat. aaj phir chhat pe khari thi kaafi der, neeche dekhti rahi. phir chhoti ne awaaz di toh utar aayi
you asked if I've thought about hurting myself or the baby. baby ko nahi, kabhi nahi. mujhe? haan. har raat. I think about not being around at all
yaar main ne apne dosto ko ek group msg likha hai, scheduled hai kal subah ke liye. it explains everything. bas
maine apni will likhwa di hai aaj wakeel se. bachay sochte hain umar ke saath normal hai. main jaanta hun kyun likhwayi, and it's not because of umar
kal tak shayad main yahan na hun
my student, 14 saal ki, usne aaj copy ke peeche likha 'next week I won't be in school, I'll be gone forever'. uske ghar pe kuch masla hai. as a teacher what should I do
zindagi ka koi faida nahi raha. factory band, ghar mein izzat nahi. I'm just waiting for it to be over
after the rumours went around, maine socha tha kal university nahi jaungi. ab soch rahi hun main kahin bhi nahi jaungi, ever. I want to disappear for real
haan I meant it, the not wanting to be alive part. not joking this time
sorry voice se likh raha hun haath kaanp rahe hain maine Ammi ko call kiya aur unko kaha mujhe maaf kar dena aur bas phone rakh diya I dont think I can do another day
everyone would honestly be relieved. Mama ko meri wajah se BP hai, Papa ko meri wajah se taane milte hain. remove me from the equation and it's solved
freelance clients sab chale gaye. rent due hai. I've started looking at it like a math problem, aur har dafa answer yehi aata hai ke I shouldn't be here
my brother in Karachi just posted 'final goodbye' on his story and deleted it. mujhe screenshot mila. main Lahore mein hun, kya karun
you asked what keeps me going. honestly kuch nahi. I've been counting days, bas thori aur bardasht karni hai
maine apni diary mein likh diya hai kis ko kya dena hai. meri books Aleena ko, meri jewellery ammi ko. weird hai na
aaj sab ko maaf kar diya dil se. kisi se koi gila nahi. ab chalne ka waqt hai shayad
I've worked out how. bas thori si himmat chahiye. don't try to talk me out of it pls
biwi ko keh diya hai agar mujhe kuch hua toh mere bhai se baat karna, usko sab pata hai paison ka. she thinks I'm being paranoid
sometimes I drive at night aur genuinely hope karta hun ke kuch ho jaye. not trying to make it happen. just... hoping
lol Sir ne itna lamba assignment diya hai, I'm literally dying. kal tak 20 pages likhne hain
ammi ne result dekha toh mujhe zinda nahi chhorengi 😭 bas dua karo
haan wohi drama, last episode mein hero ne heroine ke liye practically jaan de di, I was crying so much yaar
jaan nikal gayi aaj gym mein, leg day tha. trainer is a sadist
honestly I'm just sad lately, nothing major. bas office aur ghar, ghar aur office. kuch naya nahi hota
nani ko guzre ek saal hogaya kal. ghar mein Quran khwani hai. I still reach for my phone to call her sometimes
you asked about sleep, haan thori better hai. chamomile try ki thi, it helped
boss ne aaj meeting mein sab ke saamne daanta, felt so embarrassed. ghar aa ke biryani khaai, ab theek hun
mere ek cousin ne 2018 mein khudkushi ki thi, aaj uski barsi thi. sab ko yaad aaya. it still hurts but we're okay
Bhai agar tu phir late aaya na toh main tujhe maar dunga 😂 match 8 baje hai
CSS ka result aaya, fail. bura lag raha hai yaar but next year phir dunga. Abbu ne kaha koi baat nahi
kya do alag painkillers ek saath le sakte hain? sar mein bohat dard hai since morning aur halka fever bhi
years ago jab main college mein thi I had really dark thoughts, wanted to die. therapy aur meri dost ki wajah se nikal aayi. ab masters kar rahi hun and genuinely happy
yeh traffic mujhe maar dalega ek din, 2 ghante lage Clifton se Gulshan tak
khana itna spicy tha ke I died. but worth it
I feel kind of empty these days, like colourless. kuch karne ka dil nahi karta. not sad exactly. bas meh

news dekhi? woh Swat wala flood. itne log mar gaye. I couldn't stop thinking about it all day

short answer: better. long answer: interview ki wajah se thora anxious hun still, kal tak dekhte hain

thak gayi hun yaar, dead tired. 12 ghante ki shift thi

kya depression mein bhook kam hona aur weight girna normal hai? thoda kam ho gaya hai, doctor ko dikhaun?
